howTitle: Three steps to become an active founder

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Share your phone once in our Telegram bot, or verify with Human Passport. Free.

steps.title: Create a wallet
steps.body: Sign in with Google or email and link your People wallet in a few taps.

steps.title: Do one testnet action
steps.body: A swap, an NFT mint or a token launch on the People testnet.

inviteLine: Invite friends: you earn when THEY do step 3.
levelL2: +{{pct}}% of your friend's L1 — not taken from them
levelsTagline: Only 2 levels. Only real, active people.

gppl.title: People's governance token
gppl.body: gPPL is the People governance token. Holders vote on DAO proposals.

gppl.title: 1,000,000 gPPL, held by the DAO
gppl.body: The whole supply sits in the DAO timelock — an on-chain contract, not a person.

gppl.title: Equal share per verified founder
gppl.body: Every verified founder gets an equal gPPL share. Distribution runs in batches from the treasury 2-of-3 multisig.

gppl.title: Multisig now, DAO voting later
gppl.body: Until there are enough verified founders, the 2-of-3 multisig decides batches and timing. After that, decisions move to DAO voting by gPPL holders.

gpplNote: Testnet: gPPL has no price and is not income. The amount per founder is announced per batch.
activeTitle: All three, or it doesn't count
activeActionsHint: Real actions: swap, stake, liquidity pool, NFT mint, token launch, governance vote. Likes and follows don't count.
bonusTitle: Bonus points from your active friends
bonusSale: +{{pts}} · buys PPL in the official sale

build.title: Launch a token
build.body: Name, ticker, supply — a short form, no code. It goes live on the testnet.

build.title: Mint club cards and NFTs
build.body: Membership cards for a club, a café or a community — as NFTs or loyalty passes.

build.title: Raise funding
build.body: Collect support for a project with reviewed contract templates — escrow, vesting, token-weighted vote.

ranksTitle: Earlier founders get a bigger multiplier
ranksHint: Applies to activity points of the founder number holder. Preliminary.
fairTitle: Built so nobody can farm it

countriesEmpty: Be the first founder from your country
countriesEmptyHint: Claim your number and put your country on the map.

faq.q: Is this a promise of income?
faq.a: No. Everything here is preliminary: points, the PPL-per-point rate and the season budget may change before mainnet. Points are a record of real activity on the testnet, not a payout guarantee.
So the reward goes to people who bring real, active friends — not to deep chains. You get points for your friends, and +30% of what your friends earn for theirs. It is not taken from your friend.
Someone who verified (Telegram phone or Human Passport), has a wallet and did at least one real testnet action: swap, stake, pool, NFT, token launch or governance vote. Sign-up alone earns nothing.

Not on the testnet. After mainnet distribution is live, 10% of your credited PPL is liquid at once and 90% unlocks weekly over 52 weeks. During the first 30 mainnet days an early sale fee applies, falling from 10% to 0%.

faq.q: What if the pool runs out?
faq.a: The program stops. The last credit is cut to what is left, and nothing new is minted to keep it going.
No. You sign in, link a wallet and verify once. Launching a token or minting an NFT takes a form, not code.
